description: This file handles setting an external OAuth token, processing OAuth callbacks, validating provider support, and rendering a token display template within the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for OAuth provider interactions, such as token management and session handling.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used to assign variables and render Smarty templates.

methods.name: hasProvider
methods.description: Checks if the specified OAuth provider is supported and properly configured.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token for the specified provider using the provided authorization code.

methods.name: mapToken
methods.description: Maps the raw token data into a format suitable for storage or further processing.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template context.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Renders the specified Smarty template to output.
